text:
Oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: inference-api-high-error-rate x3 for service=hosted-api (p95 502s) — started 2026-03-17T09:20Z
Sam: Saw it, joining bridge now. investigating logs for 502 spikes.
Tanya: I'm on the bridge, running quick query against router logs to see which model backend returning errors.
Kyle: Adding context: deploy at 09:05 had a partial rollout to eu-west; traffic shift to fewer replicas might expose queueing.
Sam: Confirmed surge from a small subset of requests hitting the shard responsible for kv-cache warmup; 502s correlate with backend timeouts.
Tanya: Mitigation: increasing retry timeout + temporary route to fallback variant that doesn't require warmup. Pushing canary rollback now.
Sam: Applied rollback for 09:05 canary. Observability: p95 error-rate down from 18% -> 3% in last 6m.
Oncall-bot: Incident bridged by Sam, Tanya. Paging suppressed for 20m to avoid duplicate alerts.
Maria: Customer impact check — no major customer dashboards reported long-term failures, some requests timed out for short windows. Opening INF ticket to track communication: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4521
Kyle: Notes for post-incident: probable causes = (1) canary had smaller replicas, (2) kv-cache cold start causing latency spikes, (3) alert sensitivity too low-level.
Sam: Agreed — owner list for follow-ups: Maria -> customer comms/ticket, Tanya -> postmortem writeup, Kyle -> infra fix (scale policy + cache warmup), Sam -> alert tuning & SLO review.
Tanya: Scheduling postmortem: propose async writeup + 1h sync next Tue 10:00 PT. Maria can you add to calendar and include SRE, Runtime, Product owners?
Maria: Added calendar invite: Postmortem - INF-4521, Tue 2026-03-24 10:00 PT. Invite includes SRE, Runtime, Product, and Eng-Infra.
Sam: Short-term alert action: reduce noise by adding a filter to the 'inference-api-high-error-rate' rule to suppress alerts for <=5m transient spikes and add a dimension for backend_shard. Draft rule: ```yaml
alert: inference_api_high_error_rate
expr: increase(http_requests_total{code=~"5..",service="hosted-api"}[5m]) / increase(http_requests_total{service="hosted-api"}[5m]) > 0.05
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
  team: eng-sre
annotations:
  runbook: https://short.link/runbook-inference-502
```
Tanya: Also propose adding a pre-warm step on deploys for model backends and a CI check to validate replica counts for canaries.
Kyle: I'll create INF-4522 for infra remediation (scale policy + prewarm hooks) and link to the postmortem.
Maria: Action tracker summary (quick):
- INF-4521: Postmortem + customer comms -> Maria (due 2026-03-25)
- INF-4522: Infra changes (prewarm + autoscale tweak) -> Kyle (due 2026-04-01)
- INF-4523: Alert tuning (suppress transient, shard dimension) -> Sam (due 2026-03-22)
- INF-4524: Add canary replica guard to CI -> Tanya (due 2026-03-29)
Sam: Will follow up with metrics snapshot and a brief eval against SLOs to see if we need to change SLO window or error-budget burn rules.
Tanya: Quick ask — can we mute customer-facing alerting for the rollback period? We already suppressed paging, but want to avoid noisy customer hooks.
Maria: Done, customer hooks muted for the rollback window. Will unmute after postmortem ops signoff.
Oncall-bot: Incident resolved, paging closed. Postmortem requested by Sam.
Sam: Thanks team. Short retro note: our alert rule granularity and canary replica guard were the weak links — prioritize those in the postmortem. :thumbsup:
